title: Hymn for a Blown Speaker
caption: Distorted ambient hymn, a slow two-part harmony of a man and a woman singing long wordless vowels like a church duet, buried inside a wall of clipped, overdriven, bit-crushed static. The whole mix is brutally sidechained so the noise gulps and ducks on every slow pulse of a huge sub-bass thud, as if the recording is being fed through a blown speaker and a failing compressor. No drum kit, only the pulse. Digital dropouts, tape saturation, a beautiful melody underneath an ugly texture, patient, devastating, tender, enormous.
